Definition: something cut, i.e. a hewn timber
BiblicalUsage: These were the hewn beams set into the courts and the house Solomon built, cut timber laid in careful rows as part of the temple work.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the beams mattered because the house was built for the Lord, and no part of work done for Him is wasted.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
